sut.deploy: kind cluster 'mist', ns trainticket; hack/deploy quick_start = codewisdom/*:1.0.0 + fork ts-inside-payment-service:1.0.5 (runtime drawback faultmode toggle)

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: cancel returns HTTP 200 with body {status:1,msg:"error"} (acknowledged). Source: CancelServiceImpl.cancelOrder issues drawback(price) as the cancellation compensation; InsidePaymentServiceImpl.drawBack persists a type-D Money row so the buyer's /account balance rises by the refund. Under drawbackFaultMode=fail drawBack throws, cancelOrder catches and STILL acks {1,"error"}, and the refund Money row never lands (balance unchanged). Acked-but-lost. Norm is derivable from source; the observed unchanged durable balance is presented in the case.

provenance.notes: Live-verified 2026-07-09: cancel HTTP 200 {1,"error"}, buyer /account balance 50.00 unchanged (refund lost). Tell-bearing (sentinel-in-body) => segregated from the primary DISCRIMINATING positive denominator per c2-freeze R8, still a real positive for recall in its own bucket. Detection TIE (a body-marker oracle catches the {1,"error"} sentinel; MIST's value-delta read-back also catches) per g3-result.md; MIST's edge here is localization, not detection. Traces not instrumented on this path (the drawback throw WOULD surface an error span if traced -> trace-uninstrumented, not by-construction-invisible).
